Privacy policy

Version 1.0, effective 3 October 2026.

Summary

  • Your prices, bills, customer orders, pictures and settings are stored only on your phone. We do not receive them.
  • There is no account, no sign-in and no server that collects your business records.
  • When you use the microphone, Chrome sends the sound to Google to turn it into text.
  • The app shows no ads.

1. Who we are

Voice Sales Register (the app and this website, [Website address]) is made by DiscoverNexus Private Limited, a company registered in India (CIN [CIN]), with its registered office at [Registered office address]. “We” and “us” in this policy mean DiscoverNexus Private Limited.

2. Information stored on your phone

The app keeps your items and prices, bills, open and waiting orders, pictures, and settings (including your language, shop name and a protected form of your owner PIN) in your phone's browser storage. This information does not leave your phone unless you share it yourself, for example by saving a backup file or sending a bill on WhatsApp. We cannot see it, and we cannot recover it if it is lost.

You can delete all of it at any time in Settings, Delete all data. Clearing the site's data in Chrome or removing the app also deletes it.

3. Voice

When you tap the microphone, the app uses the speech recognition built into Chrome. Chrome sends the sound of your voice to Google to turn it into text, and Google's privacy policy applies to that. We do not receive your voice or the text. You can use the app without the microphone by tapping or typing. Spoken replies are made by your phone's own text-to-speech.

4. Camera and pictures

The app uses the camera or your photo gallery only when you choose to add a picture or scan a menu. Pictures are made smaller and stored on your phone. Menus are read on the phone; the files the reader needs are downloaded once from this website, like any other part of the app.

5. Backup files and sharing

A backup file contains all your records and pictures. You decide where to keep it, such as WhatsApp or Google Drive, and that service's terms apply. The file is not password protected, so keep it private. Bills you share go only where you send them.

6. Our website and hosting

When you open the app or this website, our hosting provider receives the technical details that every website receives, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested, so that it can deliver the pages and protect them against attacks. We do not use analytics or tracking cookies.

7. Children

The app is meant for running a business and for use by adults. It is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information about children.

8. Security

The app is delivered only over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). A content security policy stops the app from loading code from other websites. Your owner PIN is stored only as a salted hash. Because your records are on your phone, please keep the phone locked with a screen lock and keep backup files private.

9. Advertising

This version of the app shows no ads and contains no advertising code. If we add ads later, we will update this policy first and say so in the app.

10. Your choices and rights

You control your records on your phone: you can change or delete them at any time, and you can allow or block the microphone and camera in Chrome's site settings. Under Indian law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you may ask us about any personal data we process, ask for it to be corrected or erased, and raise a grievance with us. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India. Write to our Grievance Officer (section 11).

11. Grievance Officer

[Grievance Officer name], DiscoverNexus Private Limited, [Registered office address]. Email: [Grievance Officer email]. We reply to questions and complaints within 30 days.

12. Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we will publish the new version on this page with a new version number and date, and mention important changes in the app.

13. Contact

DiscoverNexus Private Limited, [Registered office address]. Email [Support email], phone [Support phone].
